CustomField.description: The event's own CreatedDate, i.e. when it was published rather than when it was admitted. Compare against the row's CreatedDate to measure delivery lag; a large gap on many rows at once is the signature of a redelivery. Retention is driven by CreatedDate, not this field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the Platform Event was published. The record's Created Date is when it was processed; a wide gap indicates delivery lag or redelivery.
CustomField.label: Event Published At
